title: Glowing submarine
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffaa' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffffaa' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='48' ry='34' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- water glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='40' ry='10' fill='#2a6b7c' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- submarine body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='34' ry='18' fill='#f2c23a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='34' ry='14' fill='#ffdb5c'/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='26' ry='8' fill='#ffefa8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- conning tower -->
  <rect x='42' y='30' width='16' height='14' rx='4' fill='#e8a92a'/>
  <rect x='45' y='27' width='10' height='5' rx='2' fill='#c98a1a'/>
  <!-- periscope -->
  <rect x='48' y='18' width='3' height='12' fill='#c98a1a'/>
  <rect x='48' y='18' width='7' height='3' rx='1' fill='#e8a92a'/>
  <!-- portholes -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='54' r='5' fill='#7fe3ff'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='54' r='3' fill='#d6fbff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='5' fill='#7fe3ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='3' fill='#d6fbff'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='54' r='5' fill='#7fe3ff'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='54' r='3' fill='#d6fbff'/>
  <!-- propeller shaft -->
  <rect x='82' y='53' width='6' height='4' fill='#b0761a'/>
  <!-- propeller blades -->
  <ellipse cx='90' cy='49' rx='3' ry='6' fill='#9e6a16'/>
  <ellipse cx='90' cy='61' rx='3' ry='6' fill='#9e6a16'/>
  <ellipse cx='90' cy='55' rx='6' ry='2.5' fill='#b0761a'/>
  <!-- fins -->
  <path d='M20 48 L10 42 L12 52 Z' fill='#c98a1a'/>
  <path d='M20 62 L12 70 L22 66 Z' fill='#c98a1a'/>
  <!-- bubbles -->
  <circle cx='70' cy='30' r='3' fill='#a8f0ff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='24' r='2' fill='#a8f0ff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='20' r='1.5' fill='#a8f0ff' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
